name: Alexander Tyrrell
bio:
Alexander Tyrrell is a highly skilled tattoo artist specializing in the traditional style, creating timeless pieces of art with a remarkable level of precision and detail. Operating from Alfred Street Tattoo in the Gold Coast, Alexander displays meticulous cleanliness in his work, ensuring a safe and comfortable environment for his clients. His unquestionable professionalism is evident in his organised scheduling process; appointments can be conveniently made through direct messages or phone calls.
